# Pianoers.com

> Pianoers.com helps adults and parents start playing the piano: which digital piano or keyboard to buy, which online course or app to learn with, and how to practise and look after a piano. It is written by piano teachers Katarina (teaching since 2001, B.A. in Music) and Richard J. Abraham (pianist and teacher).

Prices are in US dollars and each guide says when they were last checked. Product picks follow the published test method on the How we test page. Some links are affiliate links (Amazon, ClickBank and course providers); they don't decide what is recommended, and each page says so.

## Main guides

- [Best Beginner Keyboard and Digital Pianos](https://pianoers.com/best-beginner-pianos/): Seven beginner digital pianos and keyboards from about $300 to $730, ranked by a piano teacher, with specs, pros and cons, and a piano finder.
- [Best Digital Pianos: A Piano Teacher's Picks for Every Budget](https://pianoers.com/best-digital-piano/): Digital pianos by budget, from about $500 to high-end consoles, with a comparison table, picks for beginners, intermediate and advanced players, and how key actions differ.
- [Best Online Piano Lessons: 8 Courses a Piano Teacher Recommends](https://pianoers.com/best-piano-lessons-online/): Eight online piano courses and apps compared, with prices, who each one suits, free trials and guarantees, and a 30-second quiz.
- [How to Play Piano: Teach Yourself Step by Step](https://pianoers.com/teach-yourself-piano/): A 10-step plan to learn piano by yourself, a 30-day challenge, a weekly practice schedule and free in-browser tools.
- [Piano Basics for Beginners: The Complete Guide to Starting Piano](https://pianoers.com/piano-basics-a-beginners-guide-to-the-keyboard/): The 88 keys, middle C, finger numbers, reading music, rhythm, first chords and scales, and a 20-minute practice plan.
- [Piano Scales for Beginners: The First 9 Scales to Learn](https://pianoers.com/piano-scales-for-beginners/): The first nine scales in learning order, with right- and left-hand fingerings, a play-along scale player, a 10-minute routine and a free printable chart.

## Digital pianos and keyboards

- [Acoustic vs Digital Piano: Which Should You Buy?](https://pianoers.com/acoustic-vs-digital-piano/): Sound, touch, 10-year cost, tuning, space and noise compared, with a quiz to choose between them.
- [Yamaha P-145 / P-145BT Review](https://pianoers.com/yamaha-p-145-review/): Hands-on review of the Yamaha P-145 and P-145BT, the site's top pick for beginners: keys, sound, Bluetooth, pros and cons.
- [Roland FP-10 Review: The Best Key Feel Under $500](https://pianoers.com/roland-fp-10-review/): Hands-on review of the Roland FP-10: PHA-4 keys, SuperNATURAL sound, speakers, Bluetooth MIDI, and how it compares with the Yamaha P-145.
- [Loog Piano Review: Great for Kids, Wrong for Adults](https://pianoers.com/loog-piano/): A $249, 37-key piano for children aged 3 to 8 whose keys are 21% narrower than a standard piano's.

## Learning piano

- [Piano Methods Compared: Faber, Alfred's, Bastien, Suzuki and Simply Music](https://pianoers.com/5-best-piano-methods-to-learn-quickly/): Five piano methods compared by age, approach and adult books, and how to choose one.
- [5 Best Piano Books for Adult Beginners](https://pianoers.com/best-piano-books-for-adult-beginners/): Five method books for adult beginners, compared by a piano teacher.
- [Bastien Piano Method: Is It the Right One for You?](https://pianoers.com/bastien-piano-method-is-it-the-right-one-for-you/): Pros, cons, age suitability and teaching style of the Bastien method, compared with Alfred, Faber and Suzuki.
- [Piano Practice: 4 Tips for Sessions That Work](https://pianoers.com/piano-practice-4-tips-to-successful-sessions/): One goal per session, a warm-up and cool-down, slow chunked practice with a metronome ladder, and breaks.

## Online piano courses and apps

- [Best Free and Paid Piano Learning Apps](https://pianoers.com/best-free-piano-learning-apps/): Free and paid piano apps compared for beginners, kids and adults.
- [Pianoforall Review: Is the $49 Chord-First Course Worth It?](https://pianoers.com/pianoforall-review/): How the chord-first course works, the $49 one-time price and 90-day refund, what it doesn't teach, and who should pick something else.
- [Piano Marvel Review: The App That Teaches You to Read Music](https://pianoers.com/piano-marvel-review/): Free plan vs Premium ($129.99 a year), how the SASR sight-reading test works, MIDI setup, and alternatives.
- [Simply Piano Review: Is This $170/Year App Worth It?](https://pianoers.com/simply-piano-review-the-honest-truth-about-learning-piano-with-an-app/): A piano teacher's review of the game-style app: fun for beginners and kids, weaker value for adults.
- [Skoove Review: Honest Verdict After Testing the App](https://pianoers.com/skoove-review/): Prices, the free tier, how its note and timing feedback works, who it suits and where it stops.
- [Flowkey Review](https://pianoers.com/flowkey-review/): Features, pricing, pros and cons of the song-based piano learning app.
- [Pianote Review: Learning Piano With Video Lessons](https://pianoers.com/pianote-review/): Pianote (Musora) pricing, video lessons and teacher support, the lack of real-time feedback, and who it suits.
- [Synthesia Piano Review: Fun Piano Game or Fast Track to Nowhere?](https://pianoers.com/synthesia-piano-review/): How the falling-notes game works, the $29 one-time price, free vs unlocked, keyboard setup, and whether it teaches piano.
- [PianoVision Review: Can VR Actually Teach You Piano?](https://pianoers.com/pianovision-review/): Learning piano in virtual reality with PianoVision: what works, what doesn't, and whether it's worth the price.
- [HDpiano Review](https://pianoers.com/hdpiano-review/): HDpiano's song tutorials, song selection, accuracy and cost.
- [Piano With Jonny Review](https://pianoers.com/piano-with-jonny-review/): Pricing and who the jazz-focused lessons suit, compared with Simply Piano, Pianote, Flowkey and Pianoforall.
- [Open Studio Jazz Review](https://pianoers.com/open-studio-jazz-review/): Open Studio's jazz piano courses, instructors and cost.
- [Stephen Ridley's Piano Masterclass Review](https://pianoers.com/stephen-ridley/): What the Piano Masterclass includes, what it costs ($2,997 list, often $1,397 to $1,997), how the Ridley Method works, and the refund terms.
- [Piano Career Academy Review](https://pianoers.com/piano-career-academy-review/): A concert pianist reviews the Russian-school video tutorials: curriculum, teaching style and value.
- [Worship Piano Music Academy Review](https://pianoers.com/worship-music-academy-review/): Courses, teaching style and cost for learning to play piano in worship settings.

## Piano care

- [How to Tune a Piano Yourself: Tools, Apps and 8 Simple Steps](https://pianoers.com/how-to-tune-a-piano-a-simple-guide/): The tools and apps you need, eight steps, stretch tuning and pitch raises, and when to call a technician.
- [Piano Tuning: When and Why It's Needed](https://pianoers.com/piano-tuning-when-and-why-its-needed/): When a piano needs tuning, how often, and why it matters for its sound and lifespan.
- [Piano Humidity and Temperature: The Ideal Range and How to Hold It](https://pianoers.com/climate-control-and-your-piano/): Keep a piano at 40 to 50% humidity and a steady 68 to 72°F, and what to buy to keep it stable.
- [Piano Humidifier: Keeping Your Piano Hydrated](https://pianoers.com/piano-humidifier/): Why humidity control matters, and how piano humidifiers and systems such as Dampp-Chaser work.
- [Piano Dehumidifier: Why Your Piano Needs One](https://pianoers.com/piano-dehumidifier-101-why-it-is-important/): What piano dehumidifiers do, how to choose one for a grand, upright or digital piano, and how to use one safely.
- [How to Clean and Maintain Your Piano](https://pianoers.com/how-to-clean-and-maintain-your-piano/): Steps to clean, protect and maintain an acoustic piano.
- [Are Piano Keys Still Made of Ivory?](https://pianoers.com/are-piano-keys-still-made-of-ivory/): No. The history of ivory keys, the 1989 ban, and what modern piano keys are made of.

## Pianists

- [Lang Lang: The Biography](https://pianoers.com/lang-lang-the-biography/): The life and career of Lang Lang, from child prodigy to international concert pianist.

## Free tools

- [Hover Chords: Free Piano Chord Finder for Chrome](https://pianoers.com/hover-chords/): A free Chrome extension that shows any chord on a piano keyboard when you hover over it on a chord sheet, plays it, and transposes the song.
